mapper.sql: user_id AS userId, kakao_name AS kakaoName, access_token AS accessToken, access_expires_at AS accessExpiresAt, refresh_token AS refreshToken, linked_at AS linkedAt, last_synced_at AS lastSyncedAt
mapper.select: SELECT c.user_id AS userId, c.kakao_name AS kakaoName, c.access_token AS accessToken, c.access_expires_at AS accessExpiresAt, c.refresh_token AS refreshToken, c.linked_at AS linkedAt, c.last_synced_at AS lastSyncedAt FROM user_kakao_calendar c JOIN users u ON u.user_id = c.user_id WHERE u.is_deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_kakao_calendar (user_id, kakao_name, access_token, access_expires_at, refresh_token, linked_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{kakaoName}, #{accessToken}, #{accessExpiresAt}, #{refreshToken}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE kakao_name = VALUES(kakao_name), access_token = VALUES(access_token), access_expires_at = VALUES(access_expires_at), refresh_token = VALUES(refresh_token), linked_at = NOW()
mapper.update: UPDATE user_kakao_calendar SET access_token = #{accessToken}, access_expires_at = DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL #{expiresIn} SECOND), refresh_token = COALESCE(#{refreshToken}, refresh_token) WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE user_kakao_calendar SET last_synced_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.sql: id, user_id AS userId, event_id AS eventId, kakao_event_id AS googleEventId, sync_status AS syncStatus, retry_count AS retryCount, last_error AS lastError, last_synced_at AS lastSyncedAt
mapper.select: SELECT FROM user_kakao_calendar_events WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND sync_status <> 'DELETED'
SELECT FROM user_kakao_calendar_events WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND kakao_event_id IS NOT NULL AND sync_status <> 'DELETED'

SELECT FROM user_kakao_calendar_events WHERE sync_status = 'FAILED' AND retry_count < #{maxRetry} AND updated_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL (retry_count + 1) * 10 MINUTE) ORDER BY updated_at ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_kakao_calendar_events WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND sync_status = 'FAILED' AND retry_count >= #{maxRetry}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_kakao_calendar_events (user_id, event_id, kakao_event_id, sync_status, retry_count) VALUES (#{userId}, #{eventId}, #{googleEventId}, #{syncStatus}, #{retryCount}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE sync_status = VALUES(sync_status), retry_count = VALUES(retry_count)
